set system host-name NATA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit 0 family inet address 192.168.10.1/.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family, and IP address

parameters.name: unit number
parameters.explanation: The unit number on the interface

parameters.name: family type
parameters.explanation: The family type (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: IP address with subnet
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask in CIDR notation

set interfaces.explanation: The `set interfaces` command in Junos is used to configure network interface properties such as IP addresses, VLANs, and link modes.

ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 2.2..template: interface unit unit family family address address
ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 2.2..explanation: Configure an interface with a specific family and address

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface

parameters.name: family
parameters.explanation: The protocol family to be configured on the interface

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask to be assigned to the interface

set security zones security-zone trust.explanation: This command fragment configures a security zone named `[parameter1]` within the Junos security zones hierarchy, defining a logical boundary for security policies and interfaces.

parameters.name: zone-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the safe area.

interfaces ge-0/0/0.0.explanation: Configure security zone and assign an interface to it

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: Name of the interface to be assigned to the security zone

set security zones security-zone untrust.explanation: This command fragment configures a security zone named `[parameter1]` within the Junos security zones hierarchy, defining a logical boundary for security policies and interfaces.

parameters.name: zone-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the safe area.

interfaces ge-0/0/1.0.explanation: Configure security zone and assign an interface to it

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: Name of the interface to be assigned to the security zone

set security nat source pool NATPOOL.command: set security nat source pool NATPOOL
set security nat source pool NATPOOL.explanation: This command configures a source NAT pool named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining a range of IP addresses used for translating private source IPs to public IPs.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of NAT source pool.

address 1.1.1.101 to 1.1.1.105.explanation: Configure NAT source pool with a range of addresses

parameters.name: starting IP address
parameters.explanation: The first IP address in the range

parameters.name: ending IP address
parameters.explanation: The last IP address in the range

set security nat source rule-set RS1.command: set security nat source rule-set RS1
set security nat source rule-set RS1.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule set in Junos, defining a collection of rules for translating source IP addresses in traffic matching specified criteria.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule book.

from zone trust.explanation: Configure NAT source rule set to apply from a specific zone

parameters.name: zone name
parameters.explanation: Name of the zone from which the rule set is applied

to zone untrust.explanation: Configure NAT source rule-set to a specific zone

parameters.name: zone name
parameters.explanation: Name of the zone to which the rule-set is applied

rule R1 match source-address 192.168.10..explanation: Configure NAT source rule set with a specific rule matching a source address

parameters.name: rule name
parameters.explanation: Name of the rule within the rule set

parameters.name: source address
parameters.explanation: Source address to match in CIDR notation

rule R1 then source-nat pool NATPOOL.command: rule R1 then source-nat pool NATPOOL
rule R1 then source-nat pool NATPOOL.explanation: Configure source NAT rule within a rule set to use a specific NAT pool

parameters.name: rule name
parameters.explanation: Name of the rule within the rule set

parameters.name: NAT pool name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT pool to be used for source NAT

set security nat static rule-set RS-STAT.command: set security nat static rule-set RS-STATIC
set security nat static rule-set RS-STAT.explanation: This command fragment configures a static NAT rule-set in Junos, defining a set of rules for translating private IP addresses to public IP addresses.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the static NAT ruleset.

from zone untrust.explanation: Configure static NAT rule set from a specific zone

parameters.name: zone name
parameters.explanation: Name of the zone from which the rule set applies

rule STATIC-1 match destination-address.explanation: Configure a static NAT rule within a specified rule set to match a destination address

parameters.name: rule name
parameters.explanation: The name of the static NAT rule

parameters.name: destination address
parameters.explanation: The destination IP address and prefix length to match

rule STATIC-1 then static-nat prefix 192.explanation: Configure static NAT rule within a rule set

parameters.name: rule name
parameters.explanation: Name of the static NAT rule

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.explanation: IP address prefix for static NAT

set protocols ospf area.explanation: The command `set protocols ospf area` configures an OSPF area within the OSPF protocol settings on a Junos device, defining the area's properties and interfaces.

0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/1.0.explanation: Configure OSPF protocol to include a specific interface in a designated area

parameters.name: interface_name
parameters.explanation: Name of the interface to be included in the OSPF area

set routing-options static route 0.0.0.0.explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.explanation: Target network address.

parameters.name: prefix-length
parameters.explanation: Prefix length of target network.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet mask bits of the target network address.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: Next jump address, for example 2.2.2.2.
